final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy across pc1–pc31 and the recursive resolver on pc32. All PCs now use pc32 for DNS. The zone files include the requested delegations, glue records, host records, and MX records.

I assigned `www.example.com` to pc6’s address because no web server address was specified. The configuration provides DNS records only; it does not start web or mail services. See [DNS-README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-n1radm1n/lab/DNS-README.md) for assumptions and test commands.

Static checks passed for all 31 zones, delegation addresses, and 40 startup scripts. I couldn’t run the lab or BIND’s validation tools: Docker access was denied, and BIND tools are unavailable in this environment. The configuration assumes `named` is present in the `kathara/base` image.
